name: Jyothy Labs Ltd
title: Jyothy Labs Ltd - 532926 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Jyothy Labs Q4 FY26 revenue rose 7.7% to INR717 crores, but EBITDA margin fell about 330 bps to 13.5% on crude-linked input inflation and lower realisations.
summary.overview: Q4 revenue grew 7.7% YoY to INR717 crores while gross margin fell about 400 bps to 45.2% on input cost inflation and lower realisations. FY26 revenue rose 3.5% to INR2,944 crores with volumes up 6%, EBITDA margin at 15.3% (down 230 bps) and PAT of INR333 crores. Fabric Care and Personal Care recovered strongly, Dishwash was flat in value, and Household Insecticides losses narrowed to about INR5 crores from INR25 crores. Management took about 4% price increases in March, with the full effect expected from Q1 FY27, and declined to guide on FY27 margins.

financial_highlights.change: gross margin down 320 bps; EBITDA margin down 230 bps

segments.name: Fabric Care
segments.commentary: FY26 value growth 8% and volume growth 9.5%, with liquids nearly doubling. Q4 value growth 14.4% and volume growth 17.8%, led by liquids; powders show marginal degrowth as consumers shift to liquids.

segments.name: Dishwash
segments.commentary: FY26 value down 1.3% on 6% volume growth due to price cuts, grammage increases and promotions. Q4 volume up 5% with flat value; margin reportedly fell from about 18% to about 10%, which management did not confirm. Exo bio-enzyme liquid launched in Q4.

segments.name: Personal Care (Margo)
segments.commentary: FY26 value growth 5% and volume growth 1.6%. Q4 segment grew 20% in both value and volume after GST-related disruption settled from December; soaps also got a March price increase.

segments.name: Household Insecticides
segments.commentary: FY26 sales down 1.3%; losses cut from INR25 crores to about INR5 crores. Q4 value growth about 3%. Liquid vaporizers are about 55% of the portfolio (50% last year) and coils about 45%; coil prices were raised aggressively, lowering coil volumes.

guidance_outlook: Selective price increases of about 4% at portfolio level taken in March 2026; impact largely visible in Q1 FY27 and full impact from Q2 FY27.
Management expects near-term margin pressure in Q1 FY27 and will not give FY27 margin guidance until the external environment settles, possibly in a couple of quarters.
Further price actions possible depending on input cost movement; full pass-through of cost increases not expected immediately, especially in lower unit packs.
Tax rate for FY27 expected at about 25% to 26% under Section 115BAA.
FY27 capex expected to be similar to FY26.
Volume-value gap expected to narrow over time as price increases are taken; no firm timeline given.
Management expects FY27 to be a stronger year for Personal Care and believes HI could reach profitability earlier than the end-FY27 target.
capex_capacity: FY27 capex expected to be in a similar range to FY26.
Retail reach is growing by about 50,000 to 100,000 outlets a year across general trade, with no specific geography targeted.
Maxo Aerosol (HI NPD) is profitable; volume growth in high teens in recent quarters.
demand_pricing: Q4 demand was steady overall, with urban recovery after the September GST changes; uncertainty rose late in the quarter due to West Asia developments.
Input costs: LABSA up about 60-65% from January levels; HDPE/PP packaging (about 15-20% of purchases) up about 50-55% in March and April; around 50-60% of inputs crude-linked.
Dishwash competition remains intense; management said competition has not eased in April or May.
Liquid detergent pricing is competitive with local players; management says Henko and other brands are priced at parity to competition and at a premium in some markets.
Management says the Jyothy market share has held or improved across categories, including liquid detergent, but gave no brand-wise share data.
Modern trade, e-commerce and quick commerce are growing strongly; general trade recovered across regions in Q4.
Management said the price changes across the industry are in line with peers.

qa_highlights.question: Can margins for FY27 be guided to a 13.5-14% band?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to guide on FY27 margins given extreme input and crude volatility; it may guide in a couple of quarters once conditions settle.

qa_highlights.question: Why did gross margin fall about 400 bps in Q4 when input inflation only started in March?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited inflation hitting in Q4 plus lower sales realisation from a 2-3 month lag between cost increases and price actions, along with extra grammage versus last year.

qa_highlights.question: How much price increase has been taken, and how much more is needed to offset inflation?
qa_highlights.answer: About 4% blended price increase in March, mostly visible in Q1 and fully from Q2; management did not quantify the increase needed to offset inflation.

qa_highlights.question: Why not take a higher price increase given the margin pressure?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is balancing volume retention against price; 100% of input cost increases cannot be passed on in the current demand environment.

qa_highlights.question: What is the M&A pipeline given about INR1,000 crores in cash?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is in active dialogue with a couple of targets, screens on channel, category, price point, consumer and organised trade presence, and will announce when a deal is decided.

qa_highlights.question: Has competition in dishwash eased in April and May?
qa_highlights.answer: No; management said the competitive intensity is continuing unchanged.

risks_watch: Crude-linked inflation (LABSA, HDPE, PP) and weaker rupee could keep Q1 FY27 margins under pressure.
Pass-through of the 4% price increase and whether further price actions follow; watch Q1 FY27 gross margin.
Dishwash competition and margin recovery from the reported low-teens level, given price cuts and grammage increases.
Rural demand risk if higher crude prices affect farm income.
Liquid detergent price competition from local and new players, and whether liquid price-per-use compresses further.
Timing and nature of the acquisition using about INR1,000 crores of cash.
HI profitability path: whether LV and aerosol growth can offset coil price-led volume declines.
summary.management_tone: Cautiously optimistic on volumes and Fabric Care, but clearly defensive on margins: management declined to guide FY27 margins and flagged near-term pressure from crude-linked costs. The tone was evasive on dishwash margin, competitive intensity and acquisition specifics.
key_quotes: We remain cautiously optimistic about FY27 while staying watchful of the external environment.
At this stage, we will be constrained to give any guidance on margin front.
around 50% to 60% of our inputs are crude linked directly or indirectly, and therefore, a sharp increase in the crude prices, along with a weaker rupee has put pressure on the overall cost structure.

growth.why: No FY27 revenue or margin guidance; management declined margin guidance, pointed to ~4% March price increases (full effect from Q1/Q2 FY27) and Personal Care/Fabric Care momentum, with no capacity additions or order book cited, and FY27 capex only guided similar to FY26.

rows.why: Q4 EBITDA margin fell about 330 bps to 13.5% and gross margin about 400 bps to 45.2%, with LABSA up 60-65% and HDPE/PP up 50-55% since January, and management declined to guide FY27 margins.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: FY26 volume grew 6% and Q4 Fabric Care volume rose 17.8%, but ~4% price increases taken in March and coil price hikes weigh on HI volumes, and the volume-value gap is expected to narrow only over time.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: FY27 capex guided similar to FY26 with no new plant, line or land mentioned, and utilisation is not disclosed, so no capex announcement is signalled.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management declined to guide FY27 margins and flagged crude-linked input inflation (LABSA +60-65%, HDPE/PP +50-55%) that cannot be fully passed on.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Management flagged near-term margin pressure in Q1 FY27 with only ~4% price taken against cost inflation of 50-65% on key inputs, and competition in dishwash is unchanged.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Exo bio-enzyme liquid dishwash launched in Q4 and HI expects profitability earlier than end-FY27, but no further specific launch dates were given.

rows.label: Full pass-through of ~4% March price increase
rows.when: Q1 FY27 partial, full from Q2 FY27
rows.why: The ~4% blended increase taken in March is largely visible in Q1 and fully from Q2 FY27, but management said 100% of input inflation cannot be passed on in the current demand environment.

rows.label: Acquisition using ~INR1,000 crores cash
rows.why: Management is in active dialogue with a couple of targets and the company holds about INR1,000 crores of cash and is debt free, but no deal is decided yet.

rows.label: Household Insecticides path to profitability
rows.why: Losses narrowed from INR25 crores to about INR5 crores in FY26, and management believes HI could reach profitability earlier than the end-FY27 target, though coil volume declines from price hikes are a drag.

tone.note: Management was confident on volume momentum in Fabric Care and Personal Care and on Household Insecticides losses narrowing, but was defensive on margins, declining FY27 margin guidance amid crude-linked input inflation.
